slots.decision_tested: Allocate receipt of a new oral controlled prescription separately from data transcription and clinical clarification.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Initial verbal authorization versus transcription; certified technician, ordinary technician, trainee and licensed intern roles.

slots.decision_tested: Assign counseling, final validation and release responsibilities when pharmacist supervision changes during a workflow.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Physical availability and actual supervision change after an intern begins the task; counseling and final validation remain distinct decisions.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish a delegated factual clarification or unchanged refill authorization from an independent therapy change.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Prescriber communication changes a missing administrative detail versus dose or clinical instructions; credential and pharmacist approval are specified.

slots.decision_tested: Separate collection of medication-history information from interpretation requiring professional judgment.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Collecting and entering patient answers versus resolving a clinical conflict or making a DUR decision.

slots.decision_tested: Allocate vaccine preparation, injection, clinical screening and product selection among qualified pharmacy personnel.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Administration under an established patient plan versus independent selection or alteration of that plan; avoid repeating an hours-of-experience calculation.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish clerical support tasks from pharmacy practice tasks that require a licensed role.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Payment, delivery logistics or inventory support versus prescription interpretation, medication selection or patient counseling.

slots.decision_tested: Reallocate a current technician licensee's tasks when the national certification relied on for a delegated activity lapses.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: State technician licensure remains active while national certification changes; evaluate the actual assigned act rather than employment alone.

slots.decision_tested: Allocate permitted pickup and counseling workflow during a sole pharmacist's authorized break.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Previously completed pharmacist review versus a newly arising clinical question, and pharmacist on-premises status versus actual availability.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the qualifying composition of a vaccination-service pharmacy's expanded support-personnel ratio.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Certified technicians, licensed interns and other support personnel are counted from a roster; vaccination-service conditions must be established.

slots.decision_tested: Recalculate supervisory staffing when a dedicated trainer begins independent pharmacy-support duties.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The trainer's actual duties change during the shift while the trainee continues active prescription-support work.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish intern-supervision arrangements for clinical educational activity from prescription filling and immunization-only activity.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Institutional clinical activity, dispensing duties and exclusively immunization-focused work are separately identified; any exception requires explicit source support.

slots.decision_tested: Assess personnel work-hour and rest requirements using a complete schedule rather than one employer's shift.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Cumulative practice periods, genuine rest, documented extenuating circumstances and internship-credit limits are kept separate.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate claimed education or residency equivalency for entering CDTM when ordinary experience requirements are not met.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An actual Board-recognized equivalency or applicable historical pathway is distinguished from a pharmacist's self-assessment of equivalent training.

slots.decision_tested: Assess whether professional-liability coverage supports the proposed CDTM services after an employer or insurance-policy change.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Employer-provided versus individual coverage, covered services and coverage period differ while licensure and CE remain satisfied; verify the current legal coverage requirement before drafting.

slots.decision_tested: Assess patient-specific CDTM authority when MCSR/DEA status or a binding practice restriction changes, including the applicable physician-communication duty.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: State or federal authority for the specified controlled therapy changes while professional-liability coverage and CE remain satisfied; an existing collaboration agreement does not itself resolve the changed authorization.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish CDTM-specific continuing education from general pharmacist-renewal and compounding education.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Annual specialty maintenance is compared with the general renewal cycle and the relevance of completed activities; any permitted overlap awaits verification.

slots.decision_tested: Recognize which licensing event permits a transferring pharmacist to begin Massachusetts pharmacist practice.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: NABP approval, exam completion, an employment offer and actual Board-issued authority are distinct stages.

slots.decision_tested: Determine CE obligations from the licensee's actual initial-licensure or transfer history.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: New graduate, late-year license transfer and subsequent calendar year are compared without assuming the same exemption applies to each.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a CE completion portfolio for qualifying activities, allowable credit and documentation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The portfolio contains different delivery formats and subject designations; certificate presence is separated from eligible credit and audit proof.

slots.decision_tested: Identify personal license-profile and on-site credential obligations after changes in identity or employment.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The licensee's update duties are distinguished from employer verification, badge content and an external professional profile.

slots.decision_tested: Determine which observed impairment facts trigger a practice restriction or reporting analysis.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A diagnosis or lawful medication use is distinguished from actual inability to practice safely; patient injury is not assumed.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate practice authority while an impairment-related monitoring application, admission or restriction is pending.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Application, program admission, an actual Board disposition and compliance with imposed conditions are separate statuses.

slots.decision_tested: Identify distinct personal-reporting triggers and applicable clocks in a multi-event professional-history timeline.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Arrest, conviction, another jurisdiction's action and a Massachusetts action are treated as separate legally defined events.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the reporting responsibilities of an employer and individual licensee after a substantiated professional-conduct incident.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Resignation or separation, an allegation, a completed finding and individual self-reporting are distinguished; a mandatory duty must be established from operative text.
slots.specific_source_gate: Verify the precise employer versus individual reporting triggers and responsible parties; do not infer a universal duty from an incident description.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate disclosure and Board-review requirements when a technician applicant has a nonstandard criminal or disciplinary record.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Offense classification, actual court disposition and truthful disclosure are separated from an assumed blanket eligibility rule.

slots.decision_tested: Determine what a licensee may do under the actual terms of a disciplinary or administrative status.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Suspension, probation with specified restrictions, advisory correspondence and ordinary expiration are distinguished before assigning work.

slots.decision_tested: Assess whether an institutional prescriber identifier supports an authorized prescription issuance.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An institutional roster, unique practitioner suffix, authorized employment scope and unrelated private practice are evaluated together.

slots.decision_tested: Recognize the limits of federal-employment exemptions from individual DEA registration.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Military, Public Health Service or Bureau of Prisons employment is contrasted with prescribing outside the qualifying employment scope.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a practitioner's authority to issue an out-of-state controlled prescription for the specified patient and purpose.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Prescriber profession, issuing jurisdiction, drug category and relevant Massachusetts acceptance limits are identified before any transfer or partial-fill issue.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish ordinary verification of an NP prescription from a disclosed absence of required prescriptive authority.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Omission of a supervisor's name is separated from reliable information establishing a missing authorization or required supervision arrangement.

slots.decision_tested: Assess PA prescription issuance using the actual license class, registration and supervision arrangement.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Full and temporary licensure, whose identifier is used, and issuance conditions are differentiated from retrospective review requirements.

slots.decision_tested: Apply profession-specific prescribing scope to a proposed drug use instead of relying only on a valid registration number.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Dental, podiatric or optometric clinical purpose and permitted route or drug class are contrasted with unrelated treatment.

slots.decision_tested: Identify the appropriate prescriber authorization and patient-identification framework for an animal prescription.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Animal treatment and owner identification are separated from human-patient formalities; Schedule VI authority is distinguished from federal controlled-drug authority.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the legal issuance conditions for a controlled prescription originating in a telemedicine encounter.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Encounter mode, prescriber and patient locations, applicable dated federal pathway and Massachusetts authority are specified; no extension or exception is presumed.
slots.specific_source_gate: Verify the federal telemedicine rule actually effective on the item date and all applicable MA conditions; exclude expired temporary pathways.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish a validly issued electronic prescription from an altered transmission or substituted prescribing identity.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Native electronic authorization, an electronic-to-fax conversion and a prescriber agent's transmission are evaluated for issuance requirements, without testing a later transfer.

slots.decision_tested: Determine whether the conditions for initial emergency oral Schedule II prescribing are actually established.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The emergency basis and quantity needed for the emergency period are assessed separately from subsequent documentation; a routine convenience request is not presumed to qualify.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the lawful issuance structure of a packet of future Schedule II prescriptions.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Actual issue date, earliest-fill instructions, separate prescriptions and prescriber-created postdating are distinguished without repeating a partial-fill deadline problem.

slots.decision_tested: Recognize the prescriber-side conditions that alter an initial opioid-prescription quantity limitation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Patient age, treatment context and a documented applicable exception are separated from a generic assertion of medical need.

slots.decision_tested: Determine an appropriate counseling offer and documentation workflow for an initial prescription supplied remotely.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Meaningful access to a pharmacist, patient contact and a documented refusal are distinguished from merely inserting written information.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the effect of a pickup agent's response on the patient's counseling opportunity and record.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An authorized recipient, the patient's own preference and an unavailable patient are kept distinct; authority to refuse on another's behalf requires source support.

slots.decision_tested: Recognize what counts as an offer, acceptance, actual counseling or refusal in a short encounter record.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: New therapy and a refill are not used as shortcuts; the documented communication and participant roles determine the task.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a legally supported accessible-counseling pathway for a patient with a communication disability.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Auxiliary communication assistance, qualified interpretation, patient preference and the companion's role are distinguished from the limited-English-proficiency case already present.

slots.decision_tested: Apply privacy limits to a treatment-related information request without treating every disclosure as having the same consent or minimum-necessary rule.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Treatment communication, unrelated third-party use and the type of protected record are separately identified.

slots.decision_tested: Determine who is legally entitled to a minor patient's pharmacy information in a confidential-care setting.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Age alone is separated from the minor's legal consent pathway, personal-representative status and the specific record requested; current state and federal provisions must be reconciled.
slots.specific_source_gate: Verify the applicable MA confidential-care provision together with HIPAA personal-representative rules; do not infer rights from age alone.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish consent-based sharing of Part 2 treatment records from a legally different demand for use in proceedings against the patient.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A qualifying treatment/payment/operations pathway is separated from a subpoena or litigation request and from specially protected counseling notes.

slots.decision_tested: Determine whether a patient-specific CDTM authorization permits the proposed initiation or modification of therapy.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An existing physician-prescribed therapy, a proposed new medication, the referral diagnosis and the written protocol are considered together.

slots.decision_tested: Reassess patient-specific CDTM authority after new clinical information falls outside the current referral or protocol.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A protocol-defined adjustment is distinguished from management of a new diagnosis or an excluded clinical condition.

slots.decision_tested: Identify the scope of testing and monitoring that a patient's CDTM plan authorizes.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Protocol-linked monitoring is distinguished from independent diagnosis or an unrelated test request; permissible authority must be established from the operative CDTM text.

slots.decision_tested: Select the legally required communication and documentation pathway after a CDTM drug-therapy action.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Urgent clinical information, routine modification notice, the patient medical record and responsibility among collaborating professionals are separated.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the effect of a patient's withdrawal from a specific CDTM arrangement while the general professional agreement remains active.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Individual consent withdrawal and patient re-referral are distinguished from termination or expiration of the entire collaborative service.

slots.decision_tested: Apply the appropriate patient eligibility and authorization framework for community versus hospital CDTM.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Care setting, patient age, individual referral requirements and hospital program approval are assessed together without substituting one setting's rule for another.

slots.decision_tested: Assess legal eligibility to administer a specified vaccine under the applicable patient and practice conditions.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Patient age, vaccine category, patient-specific order or standing authority and required screening are distinguished from personnel credential qualification.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the required vaccine-administration workflow when a patient objects to information sharing.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Pre-administration record lookup, VIS delivery, administration records, registry submission and registry-sharing preferences are separated.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the applicable pharmacist contraceptive-prescribing pathway and its protocol limits.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The requested self-administered product, completed screening and relevant referral condition are distinguished from filling a valid outside-prescriber prescription.

slots.decision_tested: Recognize the limits of authority to administer a non-vaccine medication already lawfully prescribed.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Drug, route, patient eligibility and administration qualifications are considered independently of authority to originate the prescription.

slots.decision_tested: Determine which pharmacist HIV-prevention prescribing pathway, if any, applies to the patient's current presentation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Pre-exposure prevention, recent exposure, possible existing infection, available test information and referral requirements are distinguished under the current protocol.

slots.decision_tested: Assess whether a proposed partner-treatment prescription fits the legally authorized EPT pathway.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Covered infection, patient versus partner identity, prescriber authorization and information requiring referral are distinguished from independent pharmacist STI treatment.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the pharmacy's return obligations and subsequent product handling from the origin and reason for the return.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The pharmacy's own dispensing error or suspected defect is distinguished from an unwanted correctly dispensed product or an item dispensed elsewhere.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate a possible institutional return or reuse pathway without importing ordinary patient-return assumptions.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Continuous institutional control, sealed unit-dose integrity and documented custody are contrasted with patient possession; a verified operative Massachusetts exception is a prerequisite.
slots.specific_source_gate: Identify an actual applicable MA institutional return/reuse exception before drafting; if unavailable, replace the candidate within Area2.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish a workflow deviation intercepted before release from a confirmed released quality-related event.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The point at which the problem was detected, whether the product reached the patient and applicable CQI definitions are explicit.

slots.decision_tested: Assess access to CQI materials separately from ordinary patient records and an investigator's request.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The written CQI program, event records, patient medical information and the legal authority for a request are distinct; no blanket confidentiality or privilege is presumed.

slots.decision_tested: Determine a CQI follow-through plan after recurring errors reveal a shared workflow problem.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Immediate correction and initial reporting are already completed; system analysis, personnel communication, continuing education and evaluation of corrective changes are assessed.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the active isotretinoin REMS authorization pathway using the patient's current risk category and required verification.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The currently effective testing and verification pathway is distinguished from a remembered legacy requirement or a previous authorization; all dates require current FDA confirmation.
slots.specific_source_gate: Verify currently effective FDA iPLEDGE requirements and implementation dates; do not preserve legacy restrictions.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish prescriber, pharmacy and patient requirements within the active mifepristone REMS pathway.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Certification and required agreements are separated from clinical eligibility and shipment logistics; no one participant's authorization substitutes automatically for another's.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a lenalidomide REMS request in which one participant's authorization or patient verification is missing.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Prescriber enrollment, pharmacy authorization and patient-specific requirements are distinguished from merely possessing an unexpired transaction number.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish an active federally required restricted-use program from a discontinued REMS and separate clinical monitoring duties.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Current FDA program status, treatment-setting restrictions and independent labeling or monitoring recommendations are checked for more than one drug.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate a request for the remaining quantity of a Schedule II prescription initiated through emergency oral authority.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Emergency oral origin versus an ordinary written or electronic order; the basis for the first partial dispensing; whether the required follow-up record is available.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate eligibility for repeated unit-dose Schedule II partial dispensing using the actual patient care status.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Documented LTCF residence or terminal illness versus an assisted-living or home-care description that does not itself establish the relevant status.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish completion of the originally authorized Schedule III-V quantity from a separately authorized refill using a dispensing ledger.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Amounts already supplied, outstanding original balance, and separately authorized refills differ while the prescription remains within its applicable time window.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate a Schedule VI continuity-supply request when the usual pharmacy is unavailable and the new pharmacy must establish treatment history.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Reliable outside dispensing history versus an unverified patient account; expired authority versus an available valid refill; an ordinary pharmacy interruption versus a declared special exception.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a previously enrolled automatic-refill request after the pharmacy learns that the treatment plan has changed.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Past enrollment consent and remaining refills coexist with a later discontinuation or dose-change communication; distinguish present authorization from the enrollment record.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the transfer pathway for an electronic controlled prescription whose billing claim was processed and later reversed.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A prepared but uncollected prescription versus an amount actually handed to the patient; billing status and physical dispensing history give different signals.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a requested refill transfer across a sequence of pharmacies with different database relationships.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A prior transfer outside a shared real-time database versus movement wholly within that database; identify which relationship applies to the proposed next transfer.

slots.decision_tested: Identify transfer-record information that must be established before the receiving pharmacy relies on the remaining refill balance.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A transfer record contains the latest dispensing date but lacks original issuance or prior-transfer information; available and missing fields are shown in a compact record.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate a second pharmacy request for the remaining quantity after an initial Schedule II partial dispensing.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The original prescription has already supported a patient handoff rather than remaining unfilled; distinguish transfer of that record from obtaining a separately authorized new order.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a follow-on dispensing request after a hospital discharge supply when the patient presents to a retail pharmacy.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The prior event was institutional discharge dispensing rather than a transferred retail prescription; distinguish the source of any continuing authorization from the supply previously provided.

slots.decision_tested: Assess release of a held new controlled prescription after an omitted identifier is verified and a proposed correction is documented.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An identifier completion versus alteration of the patient, prescribed drug, or prescriber authentication; determine which unresolved defect controls the dispensing decision.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate whether a prescriber communication resolves a discrepancy sufficiently for the pharmacist to dispense the intended prescription.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Communication confirms a clerical discrepancy versus requests a therapeutic or quantity change; the identity of the communicator and the content recorded differ.

slots.decision_tested: Identify required identification fields on a dispensed veterinary prescription label.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The patient is an animal and the person collecting is the owner or authorized agent; do not substitute human prescription-record exceptions for the container-label analysis.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the label proposed for a patient-specific compounded preparation at final dispensing.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The preparation has an assigned BUD and storage conditions rather than relying solely on the manufacturer expiration and routine commercial-product directions.

slots.decision_tested: Assess identification and dating information on a multi-drug compliance package at release.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Several medicines are combined into a patient-specific package; the component containers, outer package, and patient directions present different information.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate special-packaging requirements when a pharmacy receives a transferred prescription and a claim that the patient previously waived child-resistant packaging.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A documented blanket patient request versus a one-prescription request or an unverified statement from a caregiver; a product-specific packaging exception is separately identified.

slots.decision_tested: Identify the product-condition issue that controls release of a prepared prescription during final label and stock verification.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The prescription and printed label are otherwise correct, but the physical package has a lot-specific recall or unresolved integrity concern; distinguish unaffected stock from the affected item.

slots.decision_tested: Determine the PMP reporting correction workflow when a previously transmitted transaction is reversed or entered against the wrong patient.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A medication was actually supplied versus remained uncollected; a billing reversal versus a correction of the dispensing record; the erroneous record has already reached PMP.

slots.decision_tested: Identify permissible PMP access arrangements for a dispensing review.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Use of a separately authorized delegate account versus shared credentials; access for the current patient-care task versus curiosity or an unrelated administrative purpose.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the prospective DUR required for a refill when new clinical information is received after the original prescription was reviewed.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The medication order is unchanged, but a new interacting therapy or changed patient characteristic has appeared; prior review and current review are distinct events.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a dispensing workflow when the patient declines to provide information and the software reports a completed insurance review.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A counseling refusal, an incomplete medication history, payer adjudication, and the pharmacist assessment are separately documented rather than treated as equivalent.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the legitimacy of a patient-specific controlled prescription intended for administration at a practitioner facility.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An identified patient-specific treatment order versus a request for general clinic stock; the delivery destination alone is not the sole factual discriminator.

slots.decision_tested: Assess use of potentially mismatched PMP records during prospective dispensing review.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Similar names, conflicting identifiers, and transactions attributed to the patient create uncertainty; distinguish identity reconciliation from interpretation of a confirmed medication history.

slots.decision_tested: Identify whether the information available resolves a controlled-prescription legitimacy concern.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Prescriber authentication is documented, but the evidence addressing the specific concern is either absent or independently reconciled; repeated prior dispensing is included as a separate fact.

slots.decision_tested: Identify which ingredient and product presentation triggers the applicable restricted nonprescription-sale framework.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A combination product or an alternative listed precursor is compared with an ordinary nonlisted decongestant; the ingredient and nonprescription presentation matter rather than the brand name.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate labeling and packaging for an OTC drug removed from its original manufacturer package for sale.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The transaction is a nonprescription sale rather than a patient-specific prescription dispensing; required information carried by the original package may not accompany the new container.

slots.decision_tested: Identify a seller-side prerequisite for a restricted nonprescription decongestant sale when the purchaser meets identification and quantity conditions.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Current seller self-certification and staff training documentation versus a fully compliant purchaser transaction; buyer compliance does not settle the seller-status question.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the distribution workflow when a customer requests a manufacturer-labeled OTC naloxone product and also presents an insurance-based prescription request.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The exact marketed presentation, whether dispensing proceeds as an OTC sale or a prescription transaction, and the relevant record and labeling workflow are specified separately.

slots.decision_tested: Assess an additional dispensing request for a prescription combination product after identifying its exact formulation on a supplied federal exemption record.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Formulation-specific federal exemption status, the separately supplied Massachusetts classification, unused refill authorization, and original prescription validity are shown together; classification must be connected to the requested dispensing action.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the information that controls BUD assignment for a nonsterile preparation when a default category, preparation-specific data, and component limitations differ.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An earlier component limitation or supported stability condition is added to a preserved or nonpreserved formulation; the task is selecting the governing information rather than recalling the default table alone.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish the functions and required links of a master formulation record and a preparation-specific compounding record.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A standard formula is reused for a new batch with different ingredient lots and personnel; traceability and approval information are split across the two records.

slots.decision_tested: Identify a preparation-quality concern arising from weighing equipment, calibration status, or an undocumented formulation deviation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The prescription is valid and the finished appearance is acceptable, but a material preparation-control fact is missing or inconsistent.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the preparation-process response when aseptic assessment results disagree.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A gloved-fingertip assessment and a process simulation yield different results; preparation-process controls, corrective actions, and the evidence needed for reassessment are the focus rather than personnel licensure.
slots.specific_source_gate: Record whether the necessary current USP normative text is directly available or the exact proposition is controlled by an accessible MA source; otherwise HOLD/replace.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate use of a previously entered sterile source container in a subsequent CSP preparation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Single-dose versus multiple-dose presentation, location of first entry, and the applicable post-entry conditions are supplied; manufacturer expiration is not the only information presented.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the preparation and release controls for a sterile product made with a nonsterile starting component.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The proposed preparation begins with a nonsterile ingredient rather than solely sterile manufactured products; sterilization approach, release evidence, and BUD support are separately specified.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate a proposed CSP category and workflow after a change to the compounding location or environmental qualification.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An otherwise suitable PEC is moved or its surrounding environment changes; existing staff competency and past BUD practice remain unchanged.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the preparation controls when an intact hazardous final dosage form must be manipulated to meet a patient-specific need.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Dispensing an intact unit versus opening, crushing, or otherwise manipulating it; the proposed process differs while the hazardous-drug identity stays the same.

slots.decision_tested: Identify the distinct purposes of surface-treatment steps used to prepare a hazardous compounding work area for use.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Removal of hazardous residue, removal of soil, and microbial control are represented by separate procedures or an incompletely documented combined process.

slots.decision_tested: Assess an environmental-monitoring response when viable results, nonviable results, and affected preparation history do not point to the same operational issue.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A viable action-level result is accompanied by a separate nonviable excursion or facility problem; affected PECs and preparations are distinguished in a monitoring summary.

slots.decision_tested: Assess the response to a controlled-stock discrepancy that changes status during reconciliation.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A documented posting error explains some missing units while an unresolved remainder or evidence of theft remains; discovery, reconciliation, and confirmation are separate events.

slots.decision_tested: Identify records needed to reconstruct a controlled inventory taken while stock transactions continue.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The inventory uses a stated opening or closing basis; receipts, dispensing, quarantined stock, and pending reverse distribution cross that boundary.

slots.decision_tested: Assess acquisition authority and order documentation when a pharmacy delegates or revokes authority to execute paper DEA Forms 222.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A power of attorney is current, revoked, or absent; the signer, grantor, retained authority records, and an employee departure are distinguished from possession of a personal CSOS certificate.
slots.specific_source_gate: Verify execution, scope, revocation and retention requirements for paper-Form222 power of attorney, distinguished from CSOS credential possession.

slots.decision_tested: Select the documentation and custody pathway for controlled material that originates from different sources.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Undispensed pharmacy stock, an ultimate-user collection liner, and a partially used institutional dose have different origins despite containing the same controlled ingredient.

slots.decision_tested: Assess accountability for controlled drugs returned from a nursing unit to the hospital pharmacy.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: An intact accountable unit is returned to stock custody versus a partially administered dose is recorded as waste; reconcile nursing-unit and pharmacy records without treating both events as the same transaction.

slots.decision_tested: Assess a delivery handoff when the original delivery destination is unavailable and a third party proposes accepting the package.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A patient-authorized representative, an identified pharmacy agent, and an unrelated location offer different custody arrangements; patient choice and receipt evidence are documented.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the disposition and documentation of a shipment with conflicting temperature-control evidence.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The validated shipping duration, actual transit history, and available temperature record differ; a reassuring external package appearance is separately noted.

slots.decision_tested: Distinguish shared prescription processing from physical central filling when assigning records and handoff responsibilities.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: One partner performs only remote processing while another arrangement includes physical filling; the participating pharmacies, patient notice, and accessible audit trail are shown.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate responsibilities in a central-fill arrangement that uses robotic preparation at one pharmacy and automated pickup at the originating pharmacy.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The central-fill partner prepares the product while the originating pharmacy controls patient release; a lot-specific hold and product storage needs appear at different stages of the shared workflow.

slots.decision_tested: Identify the regulated entity and process involved in a pharmacy inspection deficiency or proposed facility action.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The deficiency concerns the practice setting license or operations rather than an individual pharmacist credential; a correction plan and a separate personnel matter coexist.

slots.decision_tested: Assess continuity planning when an unplanned event develops into pharmacy closure rather than a brief operational interruption.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Temporary downtime with recoverable records becomes an indefinite or permanent closure; patient access, records custody, inventory security, and regulator communication require separate consideration.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the facility-approval pathway for moving an existing pharmacy or changing its licensed service scope.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: The legal owner and MOR remain the same while premises or compounding service scope changes; distinguish this from renewal and an ownership-only transaction.

slots.decision_tested: Interpret a supplied therapeutic-equivalence comparison when selecting a substitute for a named reference product.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Products share ingredient, strength, and dosage form but have different equivalence group or reference-product relationships; a compact supplied table contains the decisive information.
slots.specific_source_gate: Use the current official FDA Orange Book therapeutic-equivalence explanation and a correctly constructed illustrative table; verify the exact reference-product relationship.

slots.decision_tested: Assess biological-product selection using the exact FDA relationship to the prescribed reference product.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: Biosimilar status versus an interchangeable designation, prescriber instructions, and the communication method are supplied as separate facts.

slots.decision_tested: Evaluate the records and supply-chain classification of a pharmacy-to-pharmacy drug transfer requested during a shortage.
slots.legally_decisive_variation: A transfer tied to an identified patient need versus replenishment of general stock; product-tracing requirements and any controlled-stock transaction requirements are examined separately.

planning_review.review_type: independent AI planning review, not legal-professional certification
planning_review.refinement: C014 limited to liability coverage; C015 limited to drug authority/practice restriction and communication to avoid convergent CDTM decisions.
